Slowly reproduce the data wrangling from the [slides](files/09-slides-wrangling/09-sl-wrangling.html). Use careful comments to explain each steps. You can find the datasets [here](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/ilww3yawcq85tq68559eh/AOupomxeJp0JrWHwV8rh1MU?rlkey=cj6vkuwckdjzrhrb4zb85nw6y&dl=0).

In your own words, explain what the following function do. You should use the help file for each function as needed (e.g., `?filter`)

- `read_csv()`, `read_dta()`, `read_rds()`, `read_excel()`
- `glimpse()`
- `rename()`
- `select()`
- `filter()`
- `mutate()`
- `separate()`
- `pivot_longer()`
- `pivot_wider()`
- `left_join()`, `right_join()`, `inner_join()`, `full_join()`
- `bind_rows()`
- `bind_cols()`
